# Cellucid

> Cellucid is a free, open-source, GPU-accelerated web app for interactive single-cell data visualization. It shows millions of cells in the browser, in 1D, 2D and 3D embeddings such as UMAP, colored by gene expression or cell metadata, with filtering, selection, RNA-velocity overlays, figure export and community annotation.

The app runs at https://www.cellucid.com/ and needs a WebGL2 browser. It reads AnnData directly: `.h5ad` files, Zarr store folders and `.zarr.zip` archives, including the Cellucid-ready AnnData the `cellucid` Python package (Scanpy/AnnData) and the `cellucid` R package (Seurat, SingleCellExperiment) write.

## Documentation

- [Cellucid documentation](https://docs.cellucid.com/en/latest/): the web app, the Python package and the R package
- [Web app guide](https://docs.cellucid.com/en/latest/user_guide/web_app/index.html)
- [Python package guide](https://docs.cellucid.com/en/latest/user_guide/python_package/index.html)

- [Citing Cellucid](https://docs.cellucid.com/en/latest/citing.html)
